name: Borehole section / đoạn lỗ khoan
function: Biểu diễn bore boundary theo interval.
fields: diameter; interval; wellboreId. Legacy: holeID?, diameter, cumulative depth.
attachment: Host wellbore; segment continuity; không là physical installed equipment.
symbol: bore; paired wavy boundaries; label size + top/bottom.
validation: Finite positive diameter; ordered section bottoms; no unexplained overlap/gap.
edge: F01/F02/F14: empty holes; subsequent hole underream; unknown datum.
done: Correct split/extents, IDs và immutable input.

name: Underreamed interval
function: Đoạn bore được mở rộng.
fields: diameter; interval trong parent hole. Legacy startDepth/endDepth.
attachment: contained-in holeID; diameter boundary overrides tại interval.
symbol: bore; widened boundaries, no separate installed-tool glyph.
validation: Within hole interval; enlarged diameter > parent; reject intersecting intervals.
edge: F02: shuffled, adjacent, overlap, exact parent end.
done: Only enlarged span changes geometry; không mutate sort.

name: Formation / lithology band
function: Bối cảnh địa chất quanh bore.
fields: formationName; lithology?; interval; confidence.
attachment: wellbore interval reference; không host pipe.
symbol: context; muted band/hatch ngoài bore, geological legend.
validation: Interval/datum valid; overlapping interpretations có source riêng.
edge: F01/F13: repeated names; uncertain top; MD vs TVD.
done: Band/label trace source và không che bore.

name: Reservoir / target zone
function: Đánh dấu zone liên quan completion/production.
fields: zoneId; interval; purpose; fluid description optional.
attachment: annotates formation interval; references perforation/screens nếu có.
symbol: context; bracket + zone label.
validation: Không suy reservoir từ lithology; target refs và interval consistent.
edge: F08: multiple zones, commingled completion, unknown fluid.
done: Zone distinct from perforation và formation.

name: Annulus / fluid column
function: Khoảng giữa boundaries; có thể gắn fluid annotation.
fields: innerId; outerId; interval; fluidName?; density quantity?
attachment: Bounded by pipe OD và outer bore/pipe ID; wellbore reference.
symbol: annular-fill; optional light fill; label boundary IDs.
validation: Positive annular clearance khi OD/ID đủ; fluid density unit explicit.
edge: F05/F12: multiple annuli; missing ID; partial fluid level.
done: Correct occupied region; unknown clearance diagnostic.

name: Conductor casing
function: Ống chống ngoài cùng ở đoạn nông theo cấu hình.
fields: stringId; interval/start + segments(length, OD, ID?); grade/weight/connection optional với unit. Legacy pipeType + diameter/length.
attachment: contained-in hole/outer casing; supported-by hanger nếu known; segments same string.
symbol: tubular; paired boundaries + shoe anchor; label role, OD/ID và depths.
validation: Segments positive/continuous; OD < available host ID; grade không suy rating; role không auto-generate cement.
edge: F03/F14: taper; nested fit; exact segment end; duplicate string ID.
done: Generic legacy path phân biệt metadata; future graph giữ role và boundary checks.

name: Surface casing

symbol: tubular; paired boundaries + shoe anchor; label role, OD/ID và depths.
validation: Segments positive/continuous; OD < available host ID; grade không suy rating; role không auto-generate cement.
edge: F03/F14: taper; nested fit; exact segment end; duplicate string ID.
done: Generic legacy path phân biệt metadata; future graph giữ role và boundary checks.

done: Generic legacy path phân biệt metadata; future graph giữ role và boundary checks.

name: Drilling liner
function: Casing string treo trong casing trước, không kéo tới surface.
fields: linerId; interval; segments OD/ID/length; overlap interval.
attachment: contained-in parent casing/hole; supported-by liner hanger; named liner-top anchor.

validation: Top inside parent range; overlap explicit; not auto-assume hanger/support.
edge: F04: liner top at parent shoe; multiple nested liners; absent hanger.

name: Production liner
function: Casing string treo trong casing trước, không kéo tới surface.
fields: linerId; interval; segments OD/ID/length; overlap interval.
attachment: contained-in parent casing/hole; supported-by liner hanger; named liner-top anchor.

validation: Top inside parent range; overlap explicit; not auto-assume hanger/support.
edge: F04: liner top at parent shoe; multiple nested liners; absent hanger.
done: Label liner role và explicit top; generic legacy rendering không nhận là hanger-supported assembly.

name: Liner tieback / extension
function: Extension nối từ liner-top connector lên phía trên.
fields: startDepth + segments; connectorId; targetLinerId; OD/ID. Legacy tiebackID/type fields.
attachment: connects-to liner-top/PBR; supported-by upper seat where supplied.
symbol: tubular; separate extension line + connector label.
validation: Connector/endpoint continuity; no duplicate overlap counted; không dùng subsea flowline tieback meaning.
edge: F04: disconnected extension; taper; reversed endpoint.
done: Dispatch explicit extension và topology diagnostic; không silently ignore tieback.

name: Casing shoe / guide or float variant
function: Terminal shoe assembly; float function chỉ khi variant được cung cấp.
fields: stringId; bottom anchor; variant guide/float/unknown; envelope optional.
attachment: Owned by terminal string segment; connects to bottom endpoint.
symbol: tools; paired terminal triangles legacy, proposed variant + label.
validation: At terminal depth; float capability không suy từ shoe=true; avoid duplicate bottom glyph.
edge: F03: shoe false/undefined; empty segments; float vs guide label.
done: Anchor at computed bottom; generic glyph không tuyên bố check valve.

name: Float collar
function: Collar near-bottom với check-valve/plug-landing context.
fields: stringId; at; OD/ID; valve variant unknown allowed.
attachment: Inline casing, above shoe per provided assembly.
symbol: tools; short collar/check-valve marker + label.
validation: Within host; position relative shoe explicit; no guessed spacing.
edge: F03: collar at segment transition; removed/drilled-out state.
done: Inline anchor, valve role và lifecycle legible.

name: Liner hanger
function: Support liner tại casing trước.
fields: linerId; parentCasingId; at; seatProfile?; settingMethod?
attachment: supported-by parent wall/seat; supports liner; seal relation separate.
symbol: tools; slip/support glyph at liner top.
validation: Parent present at at-depth; liner ID resolved; no substitute surface CasingHanger.
edge: F04: nested liners; shared depth; unknown seat.
done: Distinct support relation và symbol; no seal inferred.

name: Casing centralizer
function: Giữ casing quanh vị trí bore tương đối theo assembly data.
fields: stringId; at/interval; envelopeOD; variant optional.
attachment: attached-to casing exterior; constrained by bore envelope.
symbol: tools; bowed/stand-off marker, schematic label.
validation: Envelope fit nếu known; không infer cement quality hay centering perfection.
edge: F03: many repeated items; eccentricity unspecified.
done: Repeated items deterministic, labels summarized có counts.

name: Stage cementing collar
function: Interface cho staged cement placement theo thiết bị được khai báo.
fields: stringId; at; portState; stageId.
attachment: Inline casing; connects-to declared annulus/stage record.
symbol: tools; ported collar symbol + state label.
validation: Stage refs và depth valid; no staged-operation simulation.
edge: F05: closed/unknown ports; two cement stages.
done: Stage identity không merge với float collar.

name: Annular cement / TOC
function: Biểu diễn cement giữa casing và bore/outer casing.
fields: innerId; outerId; interval; TOC source/uncertainty; placement status. Legacy refCasingID/startDepth.
attachment: occupies-annulus; associated with string, not lumen.
symbol: annular-fill; cement hatch; TOC depth/unknown label.
validation: Clip boundaries; top≤bottom; bottom explicit proposed; no cement quality inferred.
edge: F05: TOC outside casing; missing refs; diameter step; unknown TOC.
done: Fill đúng annulus, TOC/provenance explicit.

name: Cement plug / squeeze interval
function: Cement ở bore/lumen hoặc declared repair interval; purpose tách annular cement.
fields: interval; purpose abandonment/kickoff/repair; hostBoreId; evidenceIds.
attachment: occupies bore/lumen; optional supported-by bridge plug; squeeze target explicit.
symbol: barrier-overlay; full-bore hatch + purpose label.
validation: Not map to current annular Cement; bore boundaries exist; placement không là tested isolation.
edge: F11: plug spanning cut casing; uncertain top/bottom; failed test.
done: Plug span/purpose/evidence distinct from annular fill.

name: Declared barrier / evidence span
function: Nhóm component/evidence theo objective người nhập; overlay traceability.
fields: barrierId; objective; componentIds; evidenceIds; verification state; interval optional.
attachment: annotates components; separate from physical ownership.
symbol: barrier-overlay; bracket with explicit unknown/verified evidence text.
validation: No pass inferred from presence; evidence source/time/type required for supplied verification.
edge: F11: incomplete/failed evidence; duplicate barrier role; removed component.
done: Traceable evidence display; no certification wording.

name: Annular packoff / seal assembly
function: Seal interface tại head/hanger hoặc annular assembly.
fields: innerId; outerId; seatId; at; sealState; envelope.
attachment: seals-between named interfaces; support relation independent.
symbol: interfaces; seal blocks + state label.
validation: Seats consistent, unknown seal status retained; no rating default.
edge: F10: missing seat; multiple seals; leak annotation.
done: Seal relation distinct from hanger support.

name: Production / injection tubing string
function: Conduit completion đưa lưu thể theo purpose supplied.
fields: stringId; purpose; segments OD/ID/length; interval; connection optional.
attachment: contained-in casing/liner/bore; supported-by tubing hanger; connects-to completion tools.
symbol: tubular; inner string lines; label Tubing + size/depth.
validation: No Casing alias; segment continuity/clearance; injection purpose không suy từ pipe.
edge: F06/F12: dual strings, taper, missing ID, tubing below packer.
done: Independent tubing model/dispatch/hosts, no LLM coupling.

name: Tubing hanger
function: Support tubing ở tubing head; sealing interfaces theo cấu hình.
fields: tubingId; headId; seatId; at/elevation; ports optional.
attachment: supports tubing, supported-by head seat; seals-between declared boundaries.
symbol: interfaces; hanger glyph + tubing ID, named ports.
validation: Different from casing hanger; one seat occupancy per snapshot unless assembly supports more.
edge: F10: dual bore, cable/control-line feedthrough, unknown seat elevation.
done: Tubing support/ports/seals traceable separately.

name: Production packer

symbol: tools; paired blocks ngoài lumen; set crossed, unset outline, unknown outline + text; all strokes solid; role/state/depth/refs label. Unknown ID dùng unresolved outline.
validation: Full interval coverage, same annulus, bore clearance nếu biết, uniform diameter, no overlapping packers; stable IDs, units/MD/datum, lifecycle/evidence. Unsupported openhole/taper/setting profiles trả diagnostic.
edge: F06: tubing missing; multiple packers; openhole variant; at shoe boundary.
done: Phase 2 VERIFIED_LOCAL trong capability bounded; legacy generic vẫn riêng. Role/state, seal endpoints và QA evidence traceable; không chứng nhận hydraulic sealing/rating.

validation: Full interval coverage, same annulus, bore clearance nếu biết, uniform diameter, no overlapping packers; stable IDs, units/MD/datum, lifecycle/evidence. Unsupported openhole/taper/setting profiles trả diagnostic.

done: Phase 2 VERIFIED_LOCAL trong capability bounded; legacy generic vẫn riêng. Role/state, seal endpoints và QA evidence traceable; không chứng nhận hydraulic sealing/rating.

fields: CompletionPacker v2: id, role, innerConduitId, outerHostId, top/bottom quantities, setState, retrievable? và metadata. Phase 2 cased/liner annuli only; legacy Packer riêng.
attachment: Explicit inner/outer annulus endpoints; tubing-host spans cho production/isolation/test; liner-top → parent casing tại liner top. Không suy support từ seal.

name: Seal-bore / PBR / seal assembly
function: Receptacle/seal interface cho completion movement/connection.
fields: Completion v2 SealBore: variant, ownerId, top/bottom, od, innerDiameter?, profile?; SealAssembly: tubingId, segmentId, receptacleId, seal interval, engagement, profile?; shared metadata.
attachment: Explicit liner or tubing-packer owner and receptacle reference; seal segment owns existing tubing length once. No support or hydraulic sealing inferred.
symbol: tools; supplied receptacle walls and seal interval markers at true MD; separate not-MD-scale details, solid strokes and traceable labels.
validation: Owner/host coverage and fit, seal interval containment, geometric engagement consistency, lifecycle, unique receipt/segment occupancy, unknown profiles and unsupported overlap.
edge: F04/F06/F12-F15: partial/disengaged/unknown, missing profile/ID, unit conversion, boundaries, repeated ownership, escaped labels and immutable input.

name: Landing nipple / lock profile
function: Profile bên trong tubular cho insert tool/plug.
fields: Completion v2 LandingNipple: tubingId, segmentId, profileType, profile?, sealBoreDiameter?, noGoDiameter?, shared metadata. Segment supplies physical OD/ID/length.
attachment: Owns one existing tubing segment; distinct from an insert tool. No plug, lock compatibility or installed insert inferred.
symbol: tools; open internal profile and supplied no-go restriction, true MD interval, separate not-MD-scale detail and solid lines.
validation: References/ownership, supplied bore containment, no-go consistency, lifecycle, no overlapping unrelated tool; unknown bore/profile visible.
edge: F06/F12-F15: repeated nipples, no-go/selective/unknown, missing bore, adjacent couplings, empty or unrepresented insert, units and labels.
done: Phase 5 bounded runtime; see completion-seals.md and local evidence. Nipple and insert stay distinct; no mechanical lock verification.

name: Crossover / coupling / pup joint
function: Nối size/profile hoặc short tubular section; chi tiết chỉ khi cần.
fields: Runtime: Crossover/Coupling dùng tubingId, fromSegmentId, toSegmentId, at m/ft MD; Coupling thêm body od và innerDiameter optional in/mm. PupJoint dùng tubingId/segmentId, lấy physical quantities từ owned tubing segment. Connection texts optional.
attachment: Explicit directed adjacent tubing endpoints; tối đa một Crossover/Coupling mỗi junction. PupJoint phân loại một owned tubing segment, không cộng thêm length.
symbol: tubular; solid OD/known-ID boundaries và open lumen. Point connectors constrained theo adjacent segments; Pup Joint giữ physical interval và có detail riêng not MD scale.
validation: Refs, matching MD, unique junction/segment ownership, lifecycle/evidence, finite quantities/units; Coupling same-OD và body/host clearance; unknown ID/profile không tự suy; Pup length counted once.
edge: F03/F06/F13/F14/F15: endpoints, units, unknown bore/profiles, body clearance, short physical pup, neighboring tools, all-Pup string, immutability và escaped long labels; [crossover tests](../../tests/crossover.test.ts), [joint tests](../../tests/coupling-pup-joint.test.ts).
done: Endpoints và taper remain physically consistent.

name: Expansion joint
function: Assembly cho phép relative movement theo model supplied.
fields: hostStringId; interval; stroke quantity?; state unknown allowed.
attachment: Inline tubing; connects-to upper/lower segments.
symbol: tools; telescoping glyph + stroke label if provided.
validation: No guessed stroke/design allowance; avoid double counting length.
edge: F06: extended/retracted/unknown; crossing packer depth.
done: Explicit envelope/length và state, no mechanics simulation.

name: Control / chemical line / gauge cable
function: Đường secondary service/measurement từ surface tới tool.
fields: serviceType; endpoints; path anchors; diameter?; medium?
attachment: connects named tool/head ports; attached externally to string per configuration.
symbol: tools; thin separate line, service label; distinguish ESP power cable.
validation: Endpoints resolved; service compatible only when supplied; not silently route through seals.
edge: F07/F09/F10: shared line, feedthrough missing, crossed packer.

name: SSSV / SCSSV
function: Emergency closure device family trong producing conduit.
fields: hostTubingId; at/interval; controlType; valveState; controlPortId?; bore.
attachment: Inline tubing; surface-controlled variant connects control line/port.
symbol: tools; valve glyph + SSSV/SCSSV + open/closed/unknown text.
validation: State not inferred; control type explicit; no rating/fail-safe certification from symbol.
edge: F07: wireline-retrievable insert vs tubing-retrievable; unknown state.
done: Correct inline/control relations and state legend.

name: Sliding sleeve
function: Ports nối conduit với annulus khi state tương ứng được khai báo.
fields: hostStringId; at/interval; portState; targetAnnulusId.
attachment: Inline tubing; connects-to annulus through named ports.
symbol: tools; sleeve/ports glyph + state label.
validation: Annulus exists at depth; closed/unknown cannot be shown flowing by default.
edge: F07: multiple zones, open/closed/unknown ports.

name: ICD / ICV
function: Family inflow restriction/control; passive ICD và actuated ICV phải khác variant.
fields: hostScreenOrStringId; interval/at; deviceType; portId; state/setting optional with units.
attachment: connects zone inflow path to conduit; actuated device control connection explicit.
symbol: tools; distinct restriction/control glyph + type text.
validation: No flow coefficient/setting invented; device-specific source required before detailed variant.
edge: F08: multi-zone devices; passive no state; missing control port.
done: Variant semantics and zone association explicit.

name: Check / standing / traveling valve
function: Cho flow direction theo thiết bị; standing/traveling thuộc pump assembly nếu supplied.
fields: hostId; at; allowedDirection; valveRole; state.
attachment: Inline conduit hoặc pump child; connects flow endpoints.
symbol: tools; one-way marker + role/direction.
validation: Direction tied to named endpoints; not infer orientation from screen y.
edge: F09: two pump valves; reversed direction; unknown orientation.

name: Blanking plug / choke insert
function: Insert làm closure hoặc restriction theo role supplied.
fields: nippleId; at; insertType; bore/orifice?; state.
attachment: Locked/supported by landing nipple; seals or restricts named conduit.
symbol: tools; insert glyph + role/state label.
validation: Nipple exists; profile compatibility unresolved if missing; plug differs choke.
edge: F07: empty nipple; mismatched profile; removed insert.

name: Perforation interval
function: Liên thông casing/liner tới formation.

attachment: annotates/penetrates casing wall/cement, connects reservoir/conduit context.

name: Sand screen / slotted liner
function: Sand exclusion family; screen và slotted tubular là distinct variant.

attachment: Inline completion or lower string; contained-in hole/casing.

validation: Aperture needs manufacturer/source; not imply particle retention from hatch.
edge: F08: openhole vs cased; screen end at packer; unknown aperture.

name: Blank pipe / bull plug / lower termination

function: Lift family dùng supplied power-fluid/return paths.
